facts.business: Svarnim Trade Udyog Limited is engaged in trading activities, with exposure to raw materials such as cotton and crude oil, and operates in the Indian market with no export revenue.

auditor.name: M/s. D G M S & Co., Chartered Accountants, Jamnagar

key_risks: Geopolitical Instability: Continuing global tensions, including in the Middle East, could disrupt supply chains and international trade.
Fluctuating Raw Material Prices: Volatility in cotton, crude oil, and other key inputs, including changes in import duties, may affect production costs and margins.
Inflationary Pressures: Elevated global inflation could reduce consumer purchasing power and squeeze profit margins.
Regulatory Changes: Shifts in government policies, duty structures, or taxation could affect business operations and profitability.
Supply Chain Disruptions: Periodic logistical challenges, including shipping delays linked to regional conflicts, could affect timely deliveries and exports.
Currency Risk: Fluctuations in exchange rates may impact the cost of imports and the value of international revenues.
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, all the Related Party Transactions were entered at arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business and were in compliance with the applicable provisions of the Act and the Listing Regulations. The Company has formulated and adopted a policy on dealing with related party transactions, in line with Regulation 23 of the Listing Regulations, which is available on the website of the Company at www.svarnim.in. The Audit Committee undertakes quarterly review of related party transactions and has granted omnibus approval for repetitive transactions within specified limits.
